name: Nagato Yuki
source:
Age: 3-4/16-17 (Mental Age)
Occupation: Data Overmind Humanoid Interface

Nagato Yuki is the third person to join the SOS Brigade. At first glance, she appears to be an introverted, taciturn bibliophile. She later reveals herself to [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] as an alien created by the Data Overmind, and possesses supernatural powers as a result. She was sent to North High to watch over [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url], and over the course of her time there she comes to develop insights into being a person, as well as emotions (according to [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url]). She is commonly known by her surname "Nagato" (which is not unusual), as [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] often called her by her surname, as opposed to how he almost always called [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url] by her given name "Haruhi".
